cases.interpretation: Uncountably many optima, including binary and nonbinary distributions. Ordinary nondegenerate Newton convergence is not the acceptance criterion.
The optimum is chi=1 almost everywhere. It is a boundary solution, not an infeasible problem and not a nondegenerate quadric interface.

independent_check_to_implement: Verify objective nonnegativity, exact witness integrals, zero derivative at v=1/2, and uniqueness/nonuniqueness properties without calling the ordinary sphere Newton solver.
caveat: This extracted specification does not grant a requirement pass or reproduce any three-dimensional CAD case.
